quests.title: The Moon Adorning the Night: The Three Moons

dialogue.t: Hey there, Columbina! You seem to be in a good mood today!
You wanna play Moon Chess again or something?
Yes. It has been a while, and I somewhat miss playing.

dialogue.sit: Are the rules the same as before?

dialogue.t: Or, can you move multiple pieces per turn now because you're the Trilune Goddess?
Hehe, yeah, Paimon knows that! She was just kidding.
I shall carry on their moonlight...

quests.description: Columbina seems to have something she wants to do in the Silvermoon Hall…
